🚀 Want your AI agents to reverse engineer native binaries, closed-source desktop apps, and undocumented APIs on command?

Meet REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) — a powerful bridge and Model Context Protocol server that connects autonomous AI agents and developers directly to deep application inspection tools without needing the original source code. 

Whether you are investigating how a specific feature works in a closed-source app or auditing compiled packages for hidden dependencies, REA gives your workflow a massive superpower.

🔥 Key Features:
• Unified MCP Server Integration: Connects popular AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex straight to reverse engineering tools.
• Comprehensive Multi-Target Analysis: Deep dive into native binaries, JavaScript/Electron ASAR bundles, .NET assemblies, and firmware.
• Evidence-Backed Findings: Returns code references, raw evidence, and limitations for every traced behavior instead of just generic conclusions.
• Seamless CLI Execution: Run standalone commands for target analysis directly from your terminal.

💡 Developer Value: Dramatically accelerate feature research by instructing your AI agent to analyze proprietary app behavior, extract underlying logic, and help you build compatible versions for your own projects.

👉 Check out the repo and start building smarter AI workflows today:
https://github.com/morluto/rea

🤖 Level up your embodied AI stack: SuperMimic is changing the game for humanoid whole-body motion tracking! 

If you are training robots to run, jump, and execute complex acrobatics from motion capture data, you already know how painful traditional black-box simulation approaches can be. 

SuperMimic solves this by leveraging a single differentiable world model built on top of mjlab. It enables gradient-based optimization and physics-informed motion learning, drastically cutting down the iteration time required to train stable whole-body control policies.

🚀 Key Features:
• Differentiable world model integration for gradient-based optimization and physics-informed motion learning
• Support for both generalized and maximal coordinate representations via dedicated task IDs like SuperMimic-GenCoord-G1 and SuperMimic-MaxCoord-G1
• Modern Python dependency management and execution via astral uv for rapid environment setup and reproducibility
• Built-in support for model playback and integration with experiment tracking platforms like Wandb

Whether you're benchmarking coordinate representations for physics-based RL or deploying robust policies to real-world humanoid hardware, SuperMimic delivers smoother trajectory tracking and maximum sample efficiency.

👉 Check out the repo and start building: https://github.com/HybridRobotics/supermimic

Unlock hidden Apple features and master low-level iOS system inspection safely! 📱⚡

Are you tired of risking bootloops and APFS corruption when researching system configurations and MobileGestalt flags on modern iOS and iPadOS devices? 

Meet Erosion-CN, an advanced system configuration and MobileGestalt research toolkit built specifically for low-level system developers, security researchers, and mobile QA engineers. It lets you read, modify, validate, and persistently write hardware feature flags—like Apple Intelligence flags, spatial audio, and regional configurations—without the fear of soft-bricks.

Here is what makes Erosion-CN a must-watch repository:

🔒 Zero-byte atomic file I/O using pwrite and F_FULLFSYNC, paired with pre-apply diff previews and automated rollbacks to guarantee persistence without destroying your APFS cache.
⚙️ Dynamic runtime symbol and slot offset resolution for libMobileGestalt.dylib, completely eliminating brittle hardcoded offsets.
🛡️ Dual security vault backup system that secures original factory backups across app uninstalls and re-signatures.
📊 Deep container diagnostics including CSStore2 rapid LaunchServices mapping and power telemetry parsing from APFS database clones.

Whether you are auditing hidden hardware flags, studying robust Mach-O binary parsing, or building automated testing environments for sandboxed apps, this toolkit provides production-grade patterns for safe system state modifications.

Explore the source code and start building today:
https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN

Discover how advanced batch and PowerShell automation powers one of open source's most resilient utility suites for Windows and Office environments. 🚀

Managing Windows and Office activations across large fleets of workstations and servers shouldn't require complex dependencies. massgravel/Microsoft-Activation-Scripts is an open-source utility suite designed to seamlessly automate the activation and troubleshooting of Microsoft Windows, Office, and Extended Security Updates (ESU) using robust methods like HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS. 

Whether you are automating license management during enterprise VM provisioning or building zero-dependency internal admin toolsets, this codebase is a masterclass in native Windows scripting.

Key features engineered into the suite:
• One-line PowerShell deployment using Invoke-RestMethod and Invoke-Expression for streamlined execution.
• Resilient fallback mechanisms, including DNS-over-HTTPS queries to bypass strict ISP and DNS blocks.
• A comprehensive All-In-One batch script architecture supporting legacy and modern systems from Windows Vista onwards.
• Multiple activation backends tailored to specific product requirements.

Explore the source code and study its advanced error handling and CLI design today:
https://github.com/massgravel/Microsoft-Activation-Scripts
